The '''''Firebrand''''' was a modified [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] owned by [[Zardra Vykas]].

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Firebrand'' was referred to as the ''Rogue Moon'' in one part of ''[[Ultimate Adversaries]]''.
